div.head: Ine 26
div.ab: To fundenes cyldes fostre, ðy forman geare gesylle VI scll', ⁊ ðy æfteran geare XII, ⁊ ðy ðriddan XX, ⁊ siððan be his wlite.
LXX. To fundes cildes fostre, ðy forman geare geselle VI scill., ðy æfterran XII, ðy ðriddan XXX, siððan be his wlite.
Ad inuenticii puerii uictum primo anno VI sol. reddantur, secundo anno XII solid., tercio anno XX sol., deinceps secundum pretium suum.
{LXX} To fundes cildes fostre: ðy forman geare geselle VI sciƚƚ, ðy æfterran XII, ðy ðriddan XXX, siððan be his wlite.
For the fostering of a foundling: for the first year give 6 shillings; for the next, 12; for the third, 30; and afterwards according to his appearance.
For the maintenance of a foundling 6 shillings shall be given in the first year, 12 shillings in the second, 30 shillings in the third, and afterwards [sums] according to his appearance.
For the maintenance of a foundling six shillings is to be paid for the first year, 12 for the second, 30 for the third, and afterwards according to its appearance.
Zum Erziehungsgelde eines gefundenen Kindes gebe man im ersten Jahre 6 Schill., im folgenden 12, im dritten 30, späterhin nach seiner Körperbeschaffenheit.
For the fostering of a foundling child let 6 shillings be given in the first year, 12 in the following, 30 in the third, and afterwards according to its appearance.
div.note: Probably by the king’s representative, for it was the king who would be entitled to the wergild of a person of unknown kin.
